integrations.eventsNone: No event is selected: nothing is sent here.

events.finding.new: A finding that warns or fails and was not in the previous report. Takes the finding's severity.
events.finding.resolved: A finding of the previous report is gone.
events.project.worsened: The worst severity of the latest report is higher than before.
events.project.recovered: The worst severity of the latest report is lower than before.
events.project.stale: A project sent no report within the stale window.
events.project.reporting_again: A stale project sends reports again.
events.project.token_changed: A push token was rotated or revoked.
events.schedule.missed: A scheduled task still had not run when its next due time came.
events.schedule.failed: A run of a scheduled task failed.
events.schedule.scheduler_down: The scheduler stopped: excubia:heartbeat did not run.
events.runtime.cache_hit_ratio_low: A cache store hits less than the threshold.
events.runtime.log_spike: A log channel wrote more error entries than the threshold.
events.eol.approaching: PHP, Laravel or Node security support ends within 90, 30 or 7 days (EXCUBIA_EOL_ALERT_DAYS). Once per threshold; high at 7 days.
events.eol.reached: A project runs a PHP, Laravel or Node version whose security support has ended.
events.infrastructure.failed: A database, storage or disk check fails (new, or on the first report). Sent at once, critical.
events.health.failed: A check of the minute-level health samples fails on a server for two readings in a row. Takes the finding's severity; sent again when the failing findings change.
events.health.recovered: A failing check of the health samples no longer fails on any server.
events.health.stale: A server that was sending health samples sent none for five minutes. The health alerts ignore it until it sends again.
events.report.checks_skipped: A check was skipped because a data source failed, so the report is incomplete.
events.push.rejected: Pushes were rejected for a missing, unknown, revoked or disabled token, again and again within an hour. A leaked or forgotten token?
events.ai.budget_warning: A project's estimated AI spend this month reached 80% of its budget (set on its AI tab).
events.ai.budget_exceeded: A project's estimated AI spend this month reached its budget.
events.ai.spend_spike: Today's estimated AI spend is above the threshold share of the 7-day average.
events.ai.error_rate: The share of failed AI calls in the last hour is above the threshold.
events.billing.webhook_failures: Billing webhooks of a provider failed (5xx, retried by the provider) at least the threshold of times in the last hour.
events.billing.payment_failed: A billing provider reported failed payments in the last hour.
events.auth.failed_login_spike: An auth guard saw at least the threshold of failed logins in the last hour (brute force or credential stuffing).
events.scout.index_failures: A searchable model's Laravel Scout index jobs failed at least the threshold of times in the last hour (the search index drifts from the database).

integrations.runtimeRulesDescription: Optional alerts from the runtime data the projects push, checked every 15 minutes over the last hour. Empty turns a rule off.
integrations.cacheHitRatioHint: Alert when a cache store hits less than this share of at least 100 lookups in the last hour.
integrations.logSpike: Error-log entries per channel and hour
integrations.logSpikeHint: Alert when a log channel writes at least this many error, critical, alert or emergency entries in the last hour.
integrations.deliveryFailures: Alert when mails or notifications fail
integrations.billingWebhookFailures: Failed billing webhooks per provider and hour
integrations.billingWebhookFailuresHint: Alert when the Laravel Cashier webhooks of a provider fail at least this many times in the last hour (the provider retries them).
integrations.billingPaymentFailures: Alert when a billing provider reports failed payments
integrations.authFailedLogins: Failed logins per guard and hour
integrations.authFailedLoginsHint: Alert when an auth guard records at least this many failed logins in the last hour.
integrations.scoutIndexFailures: Failed Scout index jobs per model and hour
integrations.scoutIndexFailuresHint: Alert when the queued Laravel Scout index or remove jobs of a model fail at least this many times in the last hour.
integrations.projectsHint: Leave every box empty to send the alerts of every project.
integrations.projectGroupsHint: A project in a checked group is included, also when it joins the group later.
integrations.emailDescription: Every user who can see projects turns alert emails on for themselves in their profile, with their own minimum severity, events and projects. Mails use the app's mail settings and need a queue worker.
integrations.severitiesDescription: The severity of each event that does not take one from a finding. The minimum severity of every channel and subscription is compared with it.
integrations.aiRulesDescription: Optional alerts from the AI usage the projects push (Laravel AI SDK), with costs estimated from Settings → AI prices. Monthly budgets are set per project on its AI tab. Empty turns a rule off.
integrations.aiSpendSpike: Today's AI spend above (% of the 7-day average)
integrations.aiSpendSpikeHint: Alert once a day when a project's estimated AI spend today reaches this share of its average day over the 7 days before, from $1. 300 means three times the average.
integrations.aiErrorRateHint: Alert when more than this share of the AI calls of the last hour failed, with at least 20 calls.

aiPrices.head: AI prices
aiPrices.title: AI prices
aiPrices.description: Prices per provider and model that turn the AI usage of your projects into estimated costs. The provider is the name in the project's config/ai.php. A dated model name (gpt-4o-2024-08-06) uses the row of its model (gpt-4o). Models without a row show tokens without a cost.
aiPrices.estimates: These are estimates, not your bill: verify them against your provider. Table dated {{date}}; the defaults were last checked on {{defaultsDate}}.
aiPrices.sources: Defaults from the official pricing pages, standard tier, base prices of tiered models (checked on {{date}}):
aiPrices.addFrom: New price of {{model}} from a date
aiPrices.units: USD. Tokens per 1M; audio per second; search units per unit. Empty cache prices use the input price; an empty reasoning price counts reasoning as part of the output (as OpenAI and Anthropic report it).
aiPrices.history: Price history: a row prices the days from its date (UTC) until the next row of the same model; an empty date means since always. To change a price from a day, add a row of the model with that date ("New price from a date"): earlier days keep their price. Gemini 3.8 Flash doubles from 2027-01-01.

runtime.skipped_one: {{count}} runtime entry of a type this Excubia version does not know was skipped. Update Excubia to see it.
runtime.skipped_other: {{count}} runtime entries of types this Excubia version does not know were skipped. Update Excubia to see them.
runtime.duplicateQueriesDescription: Query shapes repeated within one request or job.
runtime.queueWaitDescription: Time from push to first attempt, per queue.
runtime.logLevelsDescription: Log entries per level and channel; the chart shows error level and above {{bucket}}.
runtime.logChartLabel: Bar chart of error-level log entries {{bucket}}: {{count}} {{during}}.
runtime.deprecationsDescription: PHP deprecations per source and PHP version, to plan upgrades.
runtime.serversDescription: Latest sample of each server that runs the scheduler.
runtime.octaneDescription: Per server and worker type. Memory is read after each request; growth above {{threshold}} MB since a worker's first request may be a leak.
runtime.reverbDescription: Per server and Reverb app. Peak connections is the most connections subscribed to a channel in one minute; channels are public / private / presence.
runtime.reverbReachable: The Reverb server answered in {{latency}} ms in the latest report.
runtime.reverbUnreachable: The Reverb server did not answer in the latest report.
runtime.billingDescription: Laravel Cashier webhooks per provider and event type. Failed ones ended with a server error (5xx) and the provider retries them; event types Cashier has no handler for are neither handled nor failed. Only the event type is received: never amounts, customers or other payload data.
runtime.authDescription: Laravel logins per auth guard: successful and failed logins with the failure rate, lockouts by the login rate limiter, and requests authenticated by a Sanctum personal access token. Passport token requests are not counted. Never users, emails, credentials, tokens or IP addresses.
runtime.scoutDescription: Laravel Scout per model, engine and operation: queued index and remove jobs with failures, the records they synced and their duration, and the searches started (without duration). Index updates with scout.queue off (Scout's default) run inline and are not recorded. Never search queries, record ids or record data.
runtime.pennantDescription: Laravel Pennant checks per feature: active and inactive results with the active share (rollout progress), first resolutions for a scope, and checks of a feature that is not defined (a removed flag still checked, or a typo). Names outside letters, digits and _ . : - \ are sent as a short hash. Never the scope (user, team) or the value.
runtime.pennantStaleRule_one: Stale flags: checked on the last day with always the same value, candidates for removal.
runtime.pennantStaleRule_other: Stale flags: checked on each of the last {{count}} days with always the same value, candidates for removal.
runtime.pennantStaleRetention: The setting asks for {{setting}} days, but runtime data is kept for {{window}} days only, so flags are judged over {{window}} days.
runtime.pennantHashedHint: The first 12 hex characters of the name's sha256: excubia-core hashes names with other characters.
runtime.statusChartLabel: Stacked bar chart of requests {{bucket}}: {{count}} requests {{during}}, {{ok}} 1/2/3xx, {{clientErrors}} 4xx and {{serverErrors}} 5xx.
runtime.durationSummary: Average and p95 per bucket. Over the range: average {{average}}, p95 {{p95}}, slowest {{max}}.
runtime.durationChartLabel: Line chart of the average and p95 request duration {{bucket}} {{during}}: average {{average}}, p95 {{p95}}, slowest {{max}}.
